scope: eligible training only; metadata guard before scientific columns, Arrow date predicate; no validation/sealed statistics
bp_variant: Koenker robust=True, auxiliary original model regressors plus intercept; diagnostic IID reference
white: original exog with automatic squares and cross-products; diagnostic IID reference
reset_covariance: HAC5, Bartlett, n/(n-k), use_t=False; chi-square Wald
influence_ranking: descending Cooks distance per model; date ascending tie break, original training date index retained
studentization: internal studentized residual, explicitly not externally studentized
robust_fit: HuberT(t=1.345) RLM, MAD scale, maxiter100,tol1e-8; point estimates only, no HAC claim
break_model: predeclared 2020 dummy and interactions with every original slope (X for OLS1; X,W for OLS3); HAC5 joint slope-difference and X-specific contrast; no breakpoint search
source_sensitivity: Reuse established original-matched identity and terminal exclusion; compare to hashed Stage1 Alpaca-only coefficient table; no new minute view
planning_effect: (1.96+0.84)*observed HAC5 SE; illustrative fixed-design normal 5%/80% scale only
rolling_slope: not run; fixed subperiod and leave-year-out tables suffice
source_era_magnitude: Not available in local verified crosswalk/spec; do not invent or search extra history
